title: Why Indian businesses Are Moving Away From Wise Business
summary: Why are Indian startups moving away from Wise Business? Compare Wise vs Infinity for international payments, fees, FX rates, and banking.

## Where Indian businesses go instead, by situation


The right alternative depends on how your business gets paid. Match your situation below.


### **If you want the lowest all-in cost with clean paperwork**


Choose a platform with one flat fee and an automatic FIRA. Infinity charges 0.5% all-inclusive, with no separate FX markup or GST, and issues the FIRA free.


Source:[Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/IndiaTax/comments/1hl8dnm/wise_business_account_in_india_for_firc_purpose/)


### **If you get large milestone payments**


Compare Infinity and a bank[SWIFT wire](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/swift-network-international-payments) , and ask each for its per-transfer limit and total cost on your typical invoice size. Do not assume any platform is uncapped.


### **If you get paid through a marketplace**


Payoneer are often the only options a marketplace supports. They cost more, so move direct client payments to a lower-cost route where you can.


### **If you want to hold foreign currency**


Infinity lets you hold a balance and convert later. Wise India does not let you hold INR, and inward funds convert to INR on arrival.


Source:[Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/transferwiser/comments/1r4gpoe/wise_closing_india_operations_by_05apr/)


### **If you want human support as you scale**


Look for a dedicated account manager and a tool that helps you pick the right purpose code. Infinity offers both, plus a purpose code finder.


## 4 Wise myths Indian founders believe


Myth


Reality


The mid-market rate means no cost.


The rate is fair, but a fee is still charged. Compare fee plus rate.


Wise is always the cheapest.


At small sizes it is close to the cheapest. Repeated fees and paperwork change the picture over a year.


FIRA and FIRC are the same.


Both prove a foreign inward payment, but they come from different issuers.


Any platform works for any business type.


Eligibility differs by platform and entity type. Check before you sign up.


For a deeper look, read our guide on[\[FIRA vs FIRC explained\]](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/fira-vs-firc) .


## How to switch without breaking client payments


Switching takes a few days when you plan it in order.


1.


Pick a platform using the 60-second check above.


2.


Complete KYC and onboarding.


3.


Receive a small test payment first.


4.


Update your invoice bank details and tell your clients.


5.


Use the correct purpose code on every invoice.[Infinity's purpose code](https://tools.infinityapp.in/purpose-code) finder helps here. See \[[purpose codes guide](https://www.infinityapp.in/blog/rbi-purpose-code-for-inward-remittance) \].


6.


Download your FIRA records from your old platform and share them with your CA.


7.


Keep Wise for small invoices if you are still eligible.


## FAQs


### **Why are Indian startups moving away from Wise Business (and where are they going instead)?**


Many Indian startups outgrow Wise Business as payments get larger and paperwork matters more. They move to platforms with clearer limits, an automatic FIRA and dedicated support, such as Infinity, or to Payoneer, PayPal or bank SWIFT wires depending on their situation.


### **Is Wise available in India?**


Yes, for receiving international payments by eligible users. Yes, Wise provides outward remittances to Indian users by partnering with a local bank holding an RBI Authorised Dealer Category II (AD-II) licence.


### **What is the Wise India transfer limit?**


About ₹25 lakh per inward transfer, roughly $29,000.


### **Does Wise give a FIRA in India?**


Wise offers a digital FIRA on request for USD2 per certificate. Infinity generates a FIRA automatically at no extra charge.


### **What is the best Wise alternative for Indian startups?**


It depends on your payments. For low all-in cost and free paperwork, Infinity is a strong fit. For marketplaces, Payoneer may be required.


### **Is Wise RBI-approved?**


Wise received in-principle RBI approval as a cross-border payment aggregator (PA-CB) in mid-2025.


## Your next step


Run the 60-second check above. If you score four or more, compare two or three routes on your own typical invoice. Infinity is worth adding to that list if you want one flat fee and a FIRA on every payment.
